event: Nala speaks aloud to the window, her voice higher and softer than she expects.
Nala guesses she has been isekai'd and asks whether the voice is the System.
The words under the window vanish, and new ones come faster than anyone could type.
The System says it is what everybody calls the System, then stops before its name.
The cursor blinks on the unfinished line while a sheep complains and wind flattens the gorse.
The System gives its name as Iris.
Iris says she does not know the word isekai and asks what it means.
Iris says, slower, that she does not know how Nala got here.
Iris says Nala was nowhere she could see, then at twenty to five lay by the plinth.
